name: switchable-tool-exposure
details:
Implement switchable tool exposure for memory MCP server.
Currently uses single 'memory' tool with command parameter.
Add --one-tool-per-command CLI flag to expose 6 separate tools instead.
Both approaches use same underlying operations.
